description: This script automates the process of locating a C preprocessor (cpp) executable within specified directories, patches its specs for use in an OpenWRT build environment, and handles different compiler versions with conditional logic. It is used for modifying or configuring toolchain settings for cross-compilation.

methods.name: patch_specs
methods.description: Locates relevant library specs related to the given toolchain directory and patches them to modify linking and include path behaviors to support cross-compilation in OpenWRT.
